data.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Copilot in Excel)
data.best: Teams already on Microsoft 365 who live in Excel, Outlook and Teams
data.price: CAD $24.43/user/mo annual (Copilot Business add-on, promo to Dec 31 2026; regular CAD $28.50); Copilot Chat included with M365
notes: 1-month trial, card required; Copilot Chat free with M365
No training; Purview retention; Canadian data at rest
data.rc: Works best when files live in OneDrive/SharePoint and are tidy tables; messy spreadsheets give weak answers.
data.canada: CAD billing; French UI; M365 data stored in Canadian datacentres, but Copilot in-country processing for Canada now slated for 2027.

data.name: ChatGPT Business (data analysis)
data.best: Ad-hoc analysis of uploaded spreadsheets and CSVs with charts in plain English
data.price: USD $20/user/mo annual or $25 monthly; 2-user minimum (per third-party summary of OpenAI pricing)
notes: Connectors to M365 and Google Drive; no Excel add-in
No training by default; residency only on Enterprise
Shows code and cites web sources
data.rc: Great for one-off analysis, but it is not a live dashboard; staff re-upload files and should check numbers before sharing.
data.canada: French UI; USD billing; Canadian data residency only on ChatGPT Enterprise/Edu, not Business.

data.name: NotebookLM + Gemini in Google Sheets
data.best: Google Workspace firms that want answers from Sheets and from their own documents
data.price: Included in Google Workspace Business Standard (about USD $14/user/mo annual; CAD at checkout); NotebookLM free for personal use
notes: No training; admin retention; no Canada region
Ask questions of sheets and docs
data.rc: Gemini in Sheets needs Business Standard or higher; Business Starter gets only basic NotebookLM.
data.canada: French UI; Workspace data regions are US/EU only, and NotebookLM ignores data-region settings.

data.name: Julius AI
data.best: Non-technical staff who want to chat with spreadsheets and get charts fast
data.price: USD $20/mo Plus ($16 annual), 1 seat; Business $450/mo ($375 annual) for 10 seats
notes: No training; deletion on request; US-only
data.rc: Credit-based plans can run out mid-project, and Team features start at the pricey Business tier.
data.canada: USD billing; data stored and processed in the US only; English interface.

data.name: Perplexity (Pro / Enterprise Pro)
data.best: Fast cited market and competitor research for owners and sales staff
data.price: Pro USD $17/mo annual ($20 monthly); Enterprise Pro USD $40/seat/mo or $400/yr
notes: Enterprise: no training; file retention controls
data.rc: Strong for web research, weaker for crunching your own spreadsheets; privacy terms apply only on Enterprise Pro, not personal Pro.
data.canada: French UI; USD billing; no published Canadian data residency.

data.name: Zoho Analytics (Ask Zia)
data.best: SMEs wanting low-cost dashboards with plain-English questions and Canadian hosting
data.price: Free (2 users, 10K rows); Standard about USD $60/mo for 5 users (yearly saves 20%); currency by country
notes: Zia LLM in Zoho DCs; Canada DCs
Ask Zia answers in plain English
data.rc: More of a BI tool than a chat box: someone has to connect data sources and build the first dashboards.
data.canada: Zoho runs Montreal and Toronto data centres for Canadian sign-ups (confirm Analytics is hosted there); French UI.

auto.name: Zapier
auto.best: The widest app coverage for no-code automations and simple AI agents
auto.price: Free (100 tasks/mo); Professional from USD $19.99/mo (annual); Team from $69/mo
notes: English-only UI; AI steps handle French
auto.rc: Task-based pricing climbs fast as volumes grow, and non-Enterprise plans must opt out of AI training.
auto.canada: English-only interface and help centre; USD billing; no Canadian data region published.

auto.name: Make
auto.best: Visual multi-step workflows with branching at a low price
auto.price: Free (1,000 credits/mo); Core from about USD $9-$10.59/mo (annual)
notes: English UI; AI modules handle French
EU/US zones; AI training not stated
auto.rc: More flexible than Zapier but harder to learn; credits are consumed per step, so busy scenarios cost more than expected.
auto.canada: USD billing; EU or US hosting only; English interface.

auto.name: Microsoft Power Automate
auto.best: Microsoft 365 shops automating approvals, forms and files
auto.price: Standard connectors with M365 plans; Premium CAD $20.40/user/mo (annual)
auto.rc: Excellent inside Microsoft 365, but premium connectors and desktop (RPA) flows add per-user or per-bot costs.
auto.canada: CAD pricing; French UI; Power Platform environments can be created in the Canada region.

auto.name: n8n (Cloud)
auto.best: Tech-savvy teams wanting powerful AI agent workflows at flat per-run pricing
auto.price: Starter EUR 20/mo (annual) for 2,500 executions; Pro EUR 50/mo
notes: Cloud trial, no card; free self-host
English UI; AI nodes handle French
auto.rc: Most powerful and cheapest per run, but a non-technical owner will usually need a consultant to build and maintain it.
auto.canada: Billed in EUR; cloud data hosted in Germany only; English interface.

auto.name: Lindy AI (Agent Builder)
auto.best: Ready-made AI assistants for inbox triage, scheduling and CRM updates
auto.price: Free trial ($50 credits, 7 days); Team USD $29.99/user/mo
auto.rc: Credit use is hard to predict; agents that send email for you need careful approval rules and testing.
auto.canada: USD billing; English interface; no Canadian data region published.

auto.name: Relay.app
auto.best: Small teams wanting simple automations with people-in-the-loop steps
auto.price: Free (100 steps/mo); paid tiers up to USD $59/mo at 25,000 steps
notes: English UI; AI steps handle French
auto.rc: Easiest builder for approvals, but its app library is small, so check your key apps are supported first.
auto.canada: USD billing; English interface; hosting location not published.

sec.name: Microsoft Defender for Business
sec.best: Affordable AI-powered endpoint protection for Microsoft 365 businesses
sec.price: CAD $4.10/user/mo (annual), up to 5 devices per user; included in M365 Business Premium (CAD $29.80)
notes: No ads use; storage US/EU etc., not Canada
Email phishing needs Defender for Office 365
sec.rc: Best value when bought inside Business Premium; on its own it protects devices but not email.
sec.canada: CAD pricing and French UI; Defender data stored in US/EU/other regions, not Canada.

sec.name: Field Effect MDR
sec.best: Canadian 24/7 managed detection and response sized for small firms
notes: Quote and free exposure report only
sec.rc: You buy a service, not just software, so pricing is by quote and often comes through an MSP.
sec.canada: Ottawa-based Canadian vendor; confirm French service and Canadian data hosting at quote.

sec.name: Huntress
sec.best: MSP-delivered managed EDR, M365/Google account protection and phishing training
sec.price: USD $8.99/endpoint/mo EDR; $4.80/identity ITDR; $2.08/learner SAT (50-seat minimum direct; none via MSP)
notes: Data handling and region not stated
sec.rc: The 50-seat direct minimum means most small firms buy it through an IT provider.
sec.canada: USD pricing; no published Canadian data region or French interface.

sec.name: KnowBe4 Security Awareness Training
sec.best: AI-driven phishing simulations and staff training at scale
notes: Phish Alert Button for Outlook and Gmail
sec.rc: Listed prices assume a 3-year term; training only works if someone reviews results and follows up.
sec.canada: Canadian data centre (AWS Montreal) for training and PhishER; French (Canada) content suits Quebec and Bill 96.

sec.name: Beauceron Security
sec.best: Canadian awareness training with risk scores and adaptive phishing
sec.price: CAD $22.99/user for a 3-year term (via CDW Canada)
sec.rc: Strong Canadian option, but you will likely buy through a reseller or MSP and need a 3-year term for best pricing.
sec.canada: Fredericton-based; data hosted in Canada (third-party source); CAD pricing through Canadian resellers.

sec.name: 1Password Business
sec.best: Team password manager with admin controls and phishing-resistant autofill
sec.price: USD $8.99/user/mo (Business, annual); Teams Starter Pack $24.95/mo for up to 10 users; CAD pricing offered
notes: Entra ID and Google Workspace sign-in
Zero-knowledge; data stored in currency region (CAD = Canada)
Autofill only on real sites; warnings
sec.rc: Only protects accounts staff actually store in it; rollout and admin recovery setup matter more than the software.
sec.canada: CAD pricing; accounts billed in CAD are stored in 1Password's Canadian region; French interface.
